caption:
Serialization & Tokenization Energy Tax — 280.4 nJ fixed binary vs. 2,212 nJ JSON & 27,679 nJ tiktoken/record (M5 Max L3 reported_j) · 109/170 L2 windows rejected for drift

Across 20,000 seeded records in CPython 3.13 on Apple M5 Max (L3 ri_energy_nj), 23 B binary unpack used 280.4 nJ/rec vs 2,212.1 nJ for json.loads (7.89x) and 27,679.2 nJ for tiktoken cl100k_base (98.7x).

• Provenance: Signed Provenance · Self-Checked (not externally peer-reviewed; studio voice is_aigc=true)
• Telemetry: reported_j (Apple M5 Max subprocess proc_pid_rusage ri_energy_nj L3 reported_j across 20,000 synthetic records (109/170 whole-chip L2 windows rejected for >5% drift).)
• Essay: https://blog.openie.dev/posts/ai-reads-human/
• Paper: https://research.openie.dev/papers/ai-reads-human/
• Replicate: https://github.com/openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments/tree/main/replicate
